_source: Blueprint G2 (first conversation, repeat line, post-memory line), K (resolution), B3/C (names, roles). 'questions' are NOT in the blueprint: A10 asks for evidence-gated investigation questions but none are written, so Nav's Claude added them (marked added: true; proofread). Each question appears once its 'requires' evidence is known.

mira.name: Mira
mira.role: Mira, 28 - schoolteacher and sharp visual witness.
first: I remember a hand, but not its face.
mira.repeat: The rope was untouched. Look at the bell.
mira.postMemory: You found the hand I could not remember.

questions.answer: The clocks agreed too perfectly. Someone made them agree.

questions.ask: Arun saw a figure on the river path.
questions.answer: A coat. A staff. I remember a hand, but not its face.

questions.ask: Leela says the lantern records memories.
questions.answer: Then the bell was not ringing for us. It was listening.

resolution.unresolvedLoop: Cannot identify who rang the bell or why the figure knew the tower.
resolution.scene: Elias places the bell clue beside the lantern residue. Mira recognizes the machine's signature and releases her memory loop.

arun.name: Arun
first: Someone carried a child toward the lantern-house.
arun.postMemory: The night kept moving after they stopped it.

questions.answer: Everyone heard it. Nobody pulled it.

questions.ask: Mira saw an apprentice lantern staff.
questions.answer: He carried it on the river too. I knew the coat.

questions.ask: Leela's notes name a child: Nia Vane.
questions.answer: Nia. She had a silver clip in her hair.

resolution.unresolvedLoop: Cannot reconcile the 2:31 watch with the 2:17 clocks or identify the child.
resolution.scene: The corrected timeline and Nia evidence are shown together. Arun accepts that the figure carried Nia after the freeze began.
resolution.lastLine: The night did not end at two-seventeen.

leela.name: Leela
leela.role: Leela, 56 - archivist and keeper of the lantern records.
first: I kept records under the floor.
The lantern was never a toy.
If you find the master log, read all of it.
leela.postMemory: Some truths were buried because I helped bury them.

questions.ask: Mira saw the apprentice lantern staff.
questions.answer: Only one apprentice ever carried it.

questions.ask: Arun found a sluice beneath the workshop.
questions.answer: The channels run under my floor. I sealed them myself.

questions.ask: The clock tower carries lantern residue.
questions.answer: Then the network is still awake.

resolution.unresolvedLoop: Cannot accept that she trusted Elias with the lantern and failed to stop him.
resolution.scene: The master log is read aloud. Leela faces the exact record of Elias's activation and her own warning.
